title: Auxiliary Power Unit — Air Intake Flap Actuator and Proximity Target Rework
abstract: Retrofit of the shrouded-bearing intake flap actuator and the repositioned proximity target on the auxiliary power unit air intake, for aircraft delivered before the production cut-in.

sections.planning_reason: Operators in dusty environments recorded flap opening times of up to eleven seconds against a design figure of four, and a smaller population of starts inhibited because the open indication never appeared. Fifty-one actuator removals were recorded across the twin-engine fleet in two years, with abrasive dust found packed into the output bearing and the anti-rotation slot in every unit examined. Four operators fell below their dispatch figure for auxiliary power unit availability as a result.
sections.description: The actuator installation is reworked so that the output shaft runs in a shrouded bearing carried by the intake shroud rather than in an exposed bush, and the mounting pattern is changed to corrosion-resistant anchor nuts with plain washers under every head to spread the load into the composite firewall panel. The proximity target that drives the open indication is moved forward onto the flap hinge arm so that the sensed gap is taken on a machined face rather than on a painted surface.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the tail cone access door and put the access stand in position. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE AUXILIARY POWER UNIT IS ISOLATED AND THAT THE FIRE BOTTLE IS SAFETIED BEFORE ENTERING THE COMPARTMENT. Do AMM-S-49-10-11-000-033-A to remove the intake flap actuator. Remove the barrel nuts LN251117-2E from the mounting pattern and clean the faying surface. Install the anchor nuts AGS522879K5 and the plain washers LN427759-6B at all eight positions. Install the reworked shroud D4910119498267 with the shrouded bearing. Move the proximity target onto the hinge arm and set the sensing gap to the value given in the accomplishment instructions. Do AMM-S-49-10-11-400-033-A to install the actuator. Do AMM-S-49-10-11-200-034-A to check the flap travel and the open indication through three full cycles. Record the embodiment and return the removed actuator.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft that are not already at the shrouded bearing standard. Aircraft from MSN S01217 onward are post-modification from build. The four-engine aircraft are not covered by this Service Bulletin because the compartment firewall position differs and no bracket has been qualified for them.
sections.material_note: Kit K4910-1004-01 contains the reworked shroud, the anchor nut and washer set and the proximity target bracket. Lead time is ten weeks. The removed actuator is returned to Aeralis for bearing analysis and the operator receives an exchange credit.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience, or within 48 months after the date of this Service Bulletin.
